question: Should acpx reserve `zeroclaw` as a permanent built-in alias for `zeroclaw acp` after the versioned documentation and live proof are corrected?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically straightforward, but VISION.md makes new agent keywords a long-term product and compatibility choice that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve the built-in
options.body: Accept `zeroclaw` as a first-class alias after correcting the stable/prerelease guidance and posting live ACP proof.

options.title: Use custom configuration
options.body: Avoid reserving a core keyword and support ZeroClaw through the existing configurable agent-command surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the built-in
recommendation.body: Accept `zeroclaw` as a first-class alias after correcting the stable/prerelease guidance and posting live ACP proof.
